Dialogs.Dialog: I'm on my way somewhere, so I'm in a bit of a hurry.
I see. Sorry for stopping you.
Street touts have been pestering me, so I just assumed.
Haha, you mistook me for one？
(Huh, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Was she on shift today？)
No. Someone suddenly called off, so I'm helping out.
Hehe. Then I'd appreciate it if you backed me up.
(It's nothing to worry about, I guess.)
(Huh, how was I supposed to do this...)
Um, how was I supposed to do this again...
You're welcome. Learn it bit by bit, okay？
Got it. I'll do my best.
Ah, isn't it time you got going？
Yeah, I guess I'll head out soon.
▲主人公＊▲. An errand for a teacher. Just over there.
We talked quite a while. I guess I'll get going.
Yeah？ Then I'll get going too.
Ow... geez, I'm going to get mad, you know？
Ah, I have to get going.
(Come to think of it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s on break now too. She might be in the break room.)
(Eh, whatever. I'll get some fresh air.)
Ow... geez, I'm going to get mad, you know？
Not really, I just noticed our breaks lined up.
(I'll get back to work in a bit too...)
Ow... geez, I'm going to get mad, you know？
The customers should calm down soon, so hang in there. Okay？
(All right！ Let's push a bit more.)
▲主人公＊▲. What's wrong？ You seem down？
Really？ I'm hungry, so maybe that's why？
Hehe, such a boy. Then I'll give you something good. Keep it secret from the teachers.
A throat lozenge. It might not fill you up much, though.
(Yeah, that takes the edge off a bit...)
Ow... geez, I'm going to get mad, you know？
Nothing in particular... is that not okay？
Hehe, kidding. I was teasing you.
Ah, I have to go. See you.
No. I saw you from far away, so I chased after you.
Ah, sorry. I stopped you and made you stand here talking. I'll go now.
We can see each other anywhere, though. When I spot you... no, never mind, bye.
We talked for quite a while.
You're right. Well, I'll go. Bye-bye.
Because it's fun. I have something to do, so I'll go. Bye-bye.
(She's gone already. I feel like she's toying with me...)
Huh, working？ You're on break, right？
Yeah, things are a bit hectic.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ gets put in charge of so much. All right, I'll help.
See, if two of us do it, we'll be done fast.
Thank you. Sorry, your break's going to be over.
I'd like you to help me with something.
Hmm, sure. But how do you ask？
(Lots of customers. At this rate, no break for a while.)
It's your break, right？ Go take it.
Don't talk back. When it's time to rest, you rest. Go on.
Okay. I got it. Thank you.
(I'm still always being looked after by ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Need me？ You could've just come inside.
Yeah. But I thought it'd be a bother if an upperclassman came all the way to your classroom.
Ah, I need to get to my seat.
Sorry. I kept talking until the bell rang. I'll go now.
You don't have to worry about it.
I came. Good boy for noticing me.
I'll go now. I might come again.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. What's up, coming all the way to my classroom？
All right, I'll go. I'll come again.
I was just thinking, there's nobody around anymore.
You know I can't say no.
I was just thinking, there's nobody around anymore.
Okay, but don't get carried away, okay？
I was just thinking, there's nobody around anymore.
Okay, that's the end. All right？
I think you know, but this time is special, okay？
Don't forget we're at work, okay？
You get carried away so easily, geez.
This is just this once, okay？
